harness-driver.patch.text:
--- original/bench
+++ campaign/bench
@@ -690,14 +690,18 @@
         if b:
             die(f"{b} is running before {name}: a measurement needs the machine alone")
         state = thermal()
+        if SYSTEM == "Darwin":
+            (out / f"{name}.power-before.txt").write_text(sh(["pmset", "-g", "batt"]))
         (out / f"{name}.thermal-before.txt").write_text(
             f"{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}\n{state}\n{swap()}\nwaited until cool: {waited}s\n")
         if not is_cool(state, a.max_temp):
-            print(f"{name}: NOT COOL ({state}), after {waited} s: it runs, and the summary names it", flush=True)
+            die(f"{name}: NOT COOL ({state}), after {waited} s: stopped before timing; preserve this attempt")
         with open(out / f"{name}.csv", "w") as o, open(out / f"{name}.err", "w") as er, \
                 watch(out / f"{name}.gpu.txt", out / f"{name}.err"):
             rc = subprocess.run(command(versions[i], name), stdout=o, stderr=er).returncode
         (out / f"{name}.thermal-after.txt").write_text(f"{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}\n{thermal()}\n{swap()}\n")
+        if SYSTEM == "Darwin":
+            (out / f"{name}.power-after.txt").write_text(sh(["pmset", "-g", "batt"]))
         print(f"{name}: exit {rc}", flush=True)
         if rc:
             (out / "host-after.txt").write_text(host_state() + "\n")
